answer: By binding each identity to a non-transferable stake and a decaying reputation vector, the protocol makes sybil proliferation cost-prohibitive across the entire staking horizon. No fable of infinite cheap identities survives when a dynamic penalty curve slashes collateral proportional to cluster overlap, and an atlas of collusive voting trees is pruned by detecting shared. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
